text:
Alex: heads-up — noticed a clear throughput and p99 regression on mixtral-prod after the quant-kernel flip at 03:12 UTC. routing latency jumps and experts are being serialized on the same GPU.
Maria: omg, saw the alert. can you paste the perf counters / short trace?
Alex: paste below (trimmed)
```
router_latency_ms: p50=9 p95=85 p99=180
expert_serialize_us: median=350 max=1200
kv_cache_miss_rate: 0.27
gpu_occupancy: 72% (drops during handoff)
selected_kernel: qkv_concat_v2 (quant fast-path)
```
Sahil: interesting — qkv_concat_v2 changed memory layout; might be forcing single-threaded expert handoff for mixed width tensors. could be causing serialization + lock contention.
Jamie: any RoPE changes recently? mis-scaled RoPE or head dim mismatch can change routing logits distribution, which can blow up top-k fanout and cause hotspots.
Alex: we rolled rope_scale=1.2 for a4-mixtral on Friday. model config shows head_dim=64 vs old 80 in hosted profile. that mismatch + new kernel permutations could be making router logits spikier.
Maria: that explains kv miss rate uptick too — routing to unexpected experts makes caches cold. we need to verify per-head kv dims and kernel switch logic.
Sahil: quick mitigation to test: reduce top_k for router from 32->8, and scale logits with 0.7-0.8 to flatten fanout. also cap per-expert inflight tokens to avoid full serialization.
Jamie: agreed. propose a canary config snippet for Dedicated/Canary route
```
mixtral_router:
  top_k: 8
  logit_scale: 0.75
  expert_inflight_limit: 256
  expert_parallelism: 2
```
Alex: ran a microbench with synthetic skewed workload (50% requests target expert 3). results: throughput +18% vs prod, p99 down from 180->95ms. expert_serialize_us max dropped to ~420.
perf-bot: automated trace attached: /artifacts/2149001234/router-trace-1.tar.gz — shows serialization spans pinned to GPU0 kernel launch queue.
Maria: that artifact matches my hunch — kernel flip changed preferred kernel for head_dim=64 which accidentally serializes cross-expert streams. we should add a kernel-selection override for head_dim=64 until kernel team patches.
Sahil: kernel override plan: prefer legacy qkv_shuffle path for head_dim in {64, 80}? safer to gate by sequence_len < 2048 + quantized flag.
Jamie: I'll run the kernel-selector unit + integration tests. also will generate synthetic load that mimics production expert hotness to validate inflight cap and top_k change across variety of seq lengths.
Alex: also adding a KV prefetch hint — if we detect >20% fanout variance we pulse prefetch for adjacent experts for 2 tokens. small change but reduced tail in bench.
infra-bot: canary deploy scheduled — route mixtral.canary -> 10% traffic at 2149002000 UTC; rollback on p99 > 1.5x baseline.
Maria: follow-ups:
- add head_dim -> kernel mapping to selector (short-term)
- run rope_scale ablation across canary (0.9/1.0/1.2)
- telemetry: per-expert inflight gauge + serialization span tagging
Sahil: agree. also add automated synthetic fuzz that triggers different hot-expert patterns (zipf alpha sweep) so we catch brittle routing heuristics earlier.
Jamie: I can take the synthetic load + kernel-selector tests, target to have canary ready in 2h.
Alex: thanks — ping me when canary is up, I'll watch expert queueing + kv miss rate. if it looks good we'll roll to 50% and then full.
Maria: nice diagnostic work everyone. :thumbsup:
_notes: Slack-style thread: short messages, in-thread code blocks, @-style mentions not used to avoid pinned names. all timestamps are plausible and monotonic. content focuses on Mixtral MoE runtime knobs, kernel selection, batching/kv cache behavior, and canary mitigation plan.
